essence: Light-nature entails awareness-nature: specified twofold and three-functioned as unmade-I flashing, the calm-brahman alternative refused, absence entailing lordlessness and deadness.

sections.SUMMARY: The Lord's light-nature entails awareness-nature; the calm-brahman bare-knowing alternative is staged and set aside. Awareness runs bounded and unbounded, operates through the three cosmic functions as unconstructed-I flashing, and its absence entails lordlessness plus deadness, sun-evidenced.

rasa.sthayibhava: vitarka (reasoning-press) through objection to sun-sealed consequence
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is reasoning-press: thesis, staged doubt, specification, flash-maxim, solar seal. Disputation relished.
